---
title: For vendors
description: How to get a tool listed, claim it, correct its pricing, and what a verified owner can and cannot change.
---

If you sell a redaction tool, this section is the whole of your relationship with this
catalog.

The principle behind all of it: **you are the authority on what you charge, and no vendor
has a path to a published number that does not pass one of our editors.** Those two facts
have to hold together. A catalog that ignored vendors would carry stale prices; a catalog
edited by the vendors it ranks would be worth nothing to a buyer.

**[Submitting a tool](/docs/vendors/submitting-a-tool)** — how a tool we are missing gets
into the queue, and what happens to it there.

**[Claiming a listing](/docs/vendors/claiming-a-listing)** — proving you work for the
vendor, which is what unlocks everything below.

**[Correcting a price](/docs/vendors/correcting-a-price)** — the only route from a vendor
to a published figure, and what it looks like once published.

**[What you can change](/docs/vendors/what-you-can-change)** — the exact field list, and
the reasoning behind where the line falls.

**[Logos and screenshots](/docs/vendors/logos-and-screenshots)** — what we need, what we do
to it, and why an upload is not immediately live.

## What you cannot buy

There is no paid placement, no sponsored row and no way to pay for a better position. Sort
order is a property of the data. If a tool in this catalog is one of ours, its listing says
so and it is ranked like everything else.
